subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – form autoresponder email
body_text:
Hi Rohan,

Thank you for your time on the call. Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form from another email you confirmed the email arrived and the autoresponder is now working.

What we covered:
- Emails can sometimes go to spam, so it is a good idea to verify your sender domain, which you can do in Settings, in the email domain section.

Your next steps:
1. Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings (you mentioned you'd do this the morning after our call).

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-04

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
